$comment: These weight a already-computed Pareto front; they never affect the search.
Weights are normalised to sum to 1 internally, so only ratios matter.
Note that even FASTEST keeps a non-zero risk weight: a profile that zeroes an
objective selects an extreme point that may be absurd on the ignored axis.
Adding a profile here requires no code change.

FASTEST.label: Fastest
FASTEST.description: Minimise rescue time. Retains a risk floor so the selection is not reckless.

FUEL_SAVING.label: Fuel Saving
FUEL_SAVING.description: Preserve vehicle delta-v budget for subsequent missions.

SAFETY_FIRST.label: Safety First
SAFETY_FIRST.description: Minimise route risk, accepting longer transfers.

BALANCED.label: Balanced
BALANCED.description: Default profile. Equal emphasis on time, fuel and risk.

CUSTOM.label: Custom
CUSTOM.description: Operator-defined. Initial values are uniform; overridden by the sliders.

tieBreaking.$comment: Applied in order until a unique winner remains. planId is unique, making the order total (OPTIMIZATION_MODEL.md §10).
